name: khaos
description: Khaos — a JavaScript Better Together gardener built with jco / ComponentizeJS.

scripts.fetch-wit: wkg get wasi:filesystem@0.2.3 --format wit -o wit/deps/ --overwrite && wkg get wasi:io@0.2.3 --format wit -o wit/deps/ --overwrite && wkg get wasi:clocks@0.2.3 --format wit -o wit/deps/ --overwrite
scripts.build: jco componentize component.js --wit wit --world-name khaos --disable http --disable fetch-event --out khaos.wasm
